Subject: Intro + proposed virtual day-bridge for Senior Backend — a few slot options

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for taking the time to meet with us. We want to run a compact virtual day that balances panel coverage and breaks across Pacific and Eastern interviewers. Below are 3 proposed slot bundles; pick whichever works best for you and we will finalize calendar invites. Each bundle is ~3.5 hours with short breaks and a 45-min deep-dive.

Option A (Pacific-friendly) — total 3h30
- 10:00–10:30 PT: Intro + recruiter check-in (Marissa)
- 10:35–11:20 PT: System design deep-dive (Jonas)
- 11:25–11:55 PT: Behavioral + culture (Laura)
- 12:00–12:15 PT: Quick wrap + ask time

Option B (Midday split) — total 3h30
- 11:00–11:30 PT / 14:00–14:30 ET: Intro + recruiter check-in
- 11:35–12:20 PT / 14:35–15:20 ET: System design deep-dive
- 12:25–12:55 PT / 15:25–15:55 ET: Behavioral + hiring manager
- 13:00–13:15 PT / 16:00–16:15 ET: Wrap

Option C (Eastern-friendly) — total 3h30
- 12:00–12:30 PT / 15:00–15:30 ET: Intro
- 12:35–13:20 PT / 15:35–16:20 ET: System design (Jonas)
- 13:25–13:55 PT / 16:25–16:55 ET: Hiring manager (Laura)
- 14:00–14:15 PT: Wrap

We have attachments: Lina's resume (we received), and a draft runbook with panel sequencing and buffer windows (daybridge_runbook_v1.pdf). If you confirm an option, we'll send invites and a short prep note.

Best,
Ben

Great — we’ll lock Option B and add a 30-minute lunch buffer between the system-design and hiring manager blocks. Below is the finalized sequencing (all times shown in PT / ET where relevant). Calendar invites will include Zoom links; we’ll also attach a brief prep doc.

Final Agenda (Option B, Day-Bridge)
- 11:00–11:30 PT / 14:00–14:30 ET — Recruiter intro + role overview (Marissa)
- 11:35–12:20 PT / 14:35–15:20 ET — System design (Jonas) — primary evaluator for architecture and scaling
- 12:20–12:50 PT / 15:20–15:50 ET — LUNCH / 30-min buffer (candidate break)
- 12:55–13:25 PT / 15:55–16:25 ET — Hiring manager deep-dive (Laura) — ownership & team fit
- 13:30–13:45 PT / 16:30–16:45 ET — Rapid wrap + action items

Panel sequencing notes:
- Jonas will lead system design and is primary for architecture scoring. If Jonas needs to extend, we have a 10-minute buffer that shortens the wrap.
- Laura will focus on team fit + roadmap ownership; please avoid system-design deep dives in that slot.
- We’ll run an async debrief doc (link below) and ask evaluators to leave scores within 2 business days. Quick verbal debrief can be scheduled if scores diverge by >1 point.

Prep materials attached: daybridge_runbook_v1.pdf (includes interviewer roles, question anchors, and scoring rubric). Please review section 3 (buffer rules) and section 6 (async debrief flow).

Next steps (for internal):
- Marissa: send calendar invites to Lina + panel with Zoom links (include candidate prep note).
- Jonas & Laura: review runbook and add 1–2 prioritized questions to the shared doc by EOD 11/11.
- Ben: will populate the async debrief doc and create the JIRA HIRE ticket.

Thanks all —
